cohort: The study participants were individuals extracted from the Truven Health MarketScan database, including women who underwent cesarean sections, patients who underwent posterior lumbar fusion, and their matched controls.
finding: The risk of developing plantar fasciitis is increased after procedures that might create transient core weakness, such as cesarean section and posterior lumbar fusion.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean section had 24.1% greater odds of developing plantar fasciitis within 12 months of delivery compared to those with vaginal births.
